labels.name: Extracellular matrix
labels.function: Outer scaffold the fiber is anchored to

labels.name: Sarcolemma
labels.function: Fragile fiber membrane shielded from contraction stress

labels.name: α-dystroglycan
labels.function: Glycosylated outer subunit; faulty glycosylation causes LGMD

labels.name: β-dystroglycan
labels.function: Transmembrane anchor bound by the cytoplasmic linker rod

labels.name: Sarcoglycans
labels.function: α, β, γ, δ subunits stabilizing the complex; mutated in LGMD

labels.name: Dystrophin
labels.function: Cytoplasmic shock-absorber rod; absent in DMD, truncated in BMD

labels.name: Actin
labels.function: Intracellular filament anchored to the membrane complex

labels.name: Caveolin-3
labels.function: Organizes membrane and its signaling; mutated in some LGMD

labels.name: Dysferlin
labels.function: Repairs microtears from contraction; mutated in LGMD

labels.name: Frontal scalp
labels.function: Balding here is a hallmark of myotonic dystrophy

labels.name: Upper eyelid
labels.function: Ptosis, with facial weakness, in myotonic dystrophy type 1

labels.name: Facial muscles
labels.function: Earliest FSHD weakness: can't smile, pucker or shut the eyes

labels.name: Biceps
labels.function: Asymmetric atrophy here is a sign of FSHD

labels.name: Heart
labels.function: Dilated cardiomyopathy; main adult cause of death in DMD/BMD

labels.name: Diaphragm
labels.function: Inspiratory weakness causes respiratory failure and pneumonia

labels.name: Lower abdominal muscles
labels.function: Weakness lets the navel rise on head lift (Beevor sign)

labels.name: Pelvic girdle muscles
labels.function: Proximal LGMD weakness: stairs, rising from a seat

labels.name: Calf muscles
labels.function: Enlarged by fat replacement (pseudohypertrophy) in DMD/BMD

labels.name: Hand muscles
labels.function: Distal weakness and grip myotonia of myotonic dystrophy 1
